english.title: Assault person assisting designated / accredited person / inspector
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) assaulted **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was assisting

(A)_[a community support officer designated under section 38(1)]_
(B)_[a policing support officer designated under section 38(1)]_
(C)_[a community support volunteer designated under section 38(1A)]_
(D)_[a policing support volunteer designated under section 38(1A)]_
(E)_[a person contracted out and designated under section 39]_
(F)_[an accredited person under a community safety accreditation scheme under section 41]_
(G)_[a weights and measures inspector accredited under section 41A]_

of the Police Reform Act 2002 acting in the execution of

(H)_[his]_
(I)_[her]_

duty
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(1) of the Police Reform Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) While the offence in section 46 has remained the same, the types of designation of police staff and volunteers have changed as 1st December 2017. For offences committed before that date refer to CJS code PL02003.
(ii) 'Designated person' includes those designated under section 38(1) or (1A) and also those civilian employees designated under this provision in one force and in relation to whom a designation is in force under section 38B under a collaboration agreement with another force, see section 46(5).

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant (constable)
Persons designated under section 38 of the Police Reform Act 2002 have no power to arrest, see section 38(6B) and paragraph 1 of Schedule 3B (excluded powers); however, there is a power to detain the person for a maximum of 30 minutes pending the arrival of a constable, see paragraph 7 of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.
other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
